apps.name: Pippa Diary
apps.author: Pippa Labs
apps.summary: Answers questions about your calendar. Reads only — it never changes anything in your diary.

apps.name: Pippa Web Search
apps.author: Pippa Labs
apps.summary: Searches the web and the news when you ask about something current, and answers with links to the sources.

apps.name: Crime Near a Place
apps.author: Hackathon Demos
apps.summary: Counts the street-level crimes reported near a UK place or postcode in the most recent published month.

apps.name: Sunrise and Sunset
apps.author: Hackathon Demos
apps.summary: Works out what time the sun rises and sets in a well-known city, and how many hours of daylight it gets, for any date you name.

apps.name: Next Dry Spell
apps.author: Hackathon Demos
apps.summary: Finds the next run of hours with no rain at a named place, and says the rain chance threshold it used.

apps.name: Flight Time
apps.author: Hackathon Demos
apps.summary: Estimates how long a flight between two airports or cities takes, and how far apart they are.

apps.name: Currency Converter
apps.author: Hackathon Demos
apps.summary: Turns an amount of money into another currency at the live European Central Bank reference rate, and always says which day that rate is from.

apps.name: ISBN Validator
apps.author: Hackathon Demos
apps.summary: Checks whether a 10 or 13 digit book number is a real ISBN using the check digit at the end of it, converts an ISBN between its 10 digit and 13 digit forms, and names the registration group it belongs to.

apps.name: Loan Repayment
apps.author: Hackathon Demos
apps.summary: Works out the monthly repayment on a loan or a mortgage from the amount borrowed, the annual interest rate and the term, and totals the interest and the full amount repaid.

apps.name: Meet in the Middle
apps.author: Hackathon Demos
apps.summary: Works out the geographic midpoint between two named places and how far each person travels to meet there.

apps.name: Near Earth Asteroids
apps.author: Hackathon Demos
apps.summary: Lists the asteroids and near earth objects passing close to Earth on a given date or range of days.

apps.name: Password Strength
apps.author: Hackathon Demos
apps.summary: Rates how strong a password is, estimates how long it would take to crack, and says what would make it stronger.

apps.name: Text Readability
apps.author: Hackathon Demos
apps.summary: Measures a piece of writing you paste in: counts the words, sentences and characters, estimates how many minutes it takes to read aloud or silently, and scores how hard it is to understand.

apps.name: Recipe Scaler
apps.author: Hackathon Demos
apps.summary: Rescales a recipe's ingredient quantities from the number of servings it makes to the number you need, and rounds every amount to something you can actually measure in a kitchen.

apps.name: Bill Splitter
apps.author: Hackathon Demos
apps.summary: Works out what each person pays when a bill is shared, adds an optional tip or service charge, and says where the odd pennies land.

apps.name: Unit Converter
apps.author: Hackathon Demos
apps.summary: Converts a measurement from one unit to another across length, weight, temperature, volume and speed.

apps.name: Wikipedia Attention
apps.author: Hackathon Demos
apps.summary: Counts how many times a Wikipedia article is read each day, and says whether attention is rising or falling.
